purpose: Find the adapter with the best generalization on the existing data, using early feedback before expanding compute.
data_policy: Freeze existing ARKitScenes/Hypersim/NYU/COCO manifests and sampling. New dataset candidates are table-only: no downloads or cleaning.
indoor_control: Retain existing fusion_indoor results as the data contrast, outside the architecture ranking. Its additional geometry run is deferred.

first_rung.baseline: Existing fusion validation at exactly 1000 steps

second_rung.condition: Review first-rung integrity, per-domain metrics, fit and learning speed. Prefer all viable candidates at a common budget before excluding a slower learner.
second_rung.baseline: Existing fusion validation at exactly 3000 steps

expansion.candidates: Fusion baseline plus the strongest one or two spatial heads after review
expansion.geometry: Short matched geometry pilots for finalists, then expand only if useful; cancel the previous unconditional four-arm 6000-step geometry queue.

numerical_protocol: Use the pinned 2268c42 trainer/configs, original 6000-step learning-rate horizon, batch16 accumulation2, fixed sample stream and losses. --stop-after only changes the stopping point; --resume restores optimizer, scheduler, RNG and data cursor.
selection: Keep macro teacher-depth AbsRel on common884 validation as preregistered. Report per-domain metrics, NYU sensor AbsRel/RMSE, selected and last checkpoints, failures, speed and memory separately.
feedback: Publish same-step metrics after every rung and inspect decoded geometry. Use paired scene uncertainty before expansion decisions. Reuse the fixed20 qualitative audit; held-out tests are final assessments, not per-rung tuning targets.
innovation: Allow a compact local-convolution plus global-attention residual adapter if existing-head evidence identifies a useful gap. Any new candidate first receives the same bounded rung, data and metric protocol; it is not automatically launched now.
claims: One-seed screening compares equal updates/examples, not equal FLOPs or convergence. Early curves guide experiments; no universal generalization winner can be inferred from the first rung.
gpu_policy: Never stop GPU; train serially and preserve resumable checkpoints.
